pages.text: The feed hops A → B with chance p each step, B → C with q, C → A with r. However it starts, it settles into the chain's steady state: the share of time in each vat is proportional to 1/(its chance of leaving), π = (1/p, 1/q, 1/r)/Σ. How fast it settles is set by the slowest hop.
